notes: Printed page = PDF page index - 26 throughout this document (e.g. PDF 115 = printed 89).

In Section 3 parameter tables the function codes (e.g. F002, A001) are rendered as 7-segment glyphs and are not present in the PDF text layer; codes were read from the rendered page images. Evidence quotes therefore often contain only the name/description text.

Many table rows in the PDF text layer are extracted out of row order (columns separated); quotes were chosen as contiguous spans where possible, and some register quotes come from the layout-mode text extraction. Values were read from the rendered pages. These records may be flagged for manual verification by the importer.
Defaults recorded are the 'EU' default column as printed. b085 (Initialization parameter selection: 00 JPN / 01 EUR, default 01) may change defaults per the manual.
A001 option 00 is labelled 'VR (Digital Operator)' on page 90 (printed) but '00 Digital operator' on page 297 and '00 (digital operator)' in the Modbus listing (page 324).

Output current monitor (1003h, d002): range printed as '0 to 999900' with resolution 0.01 [A]; Rotation direction monitor (1004h, d003) shows resolution '0.1 [Hz]' in the printed table. Copied as printed; looks questionable.

Modbus registers have high/low word pairs for 32-bit values (e.g. F001, d001, F002). Per-register Modbus function codes are not listed in the data tables; function_codes left null except for the supported function codes record.

No separate rated motor voltage, rated motor current, rated motor frequency or rated motor speed parameter was found in the parameter tables read; A082 (AVR voltage selection) recorded as Partially Equivalent for motor voltage; b012 (Electronic thermal level) recorded as motor overload protection.

No protocol selection parameter (e.g. Modbus vs other) found; P200 Serial comms mode (Standard / Free mapping) recorded as Partially Equivalent. P200 default not stated on page 297 and section 3-9 table not read.
